Hon'ble Rakesh Thapliyal, J.
Mr. Mohit Kumar Kashyap, learned counsel for the petitioners.
2. Mr. V.K.Jemini, learned Deputy Advocate General for the State.
3. Ms. Shobha Mehra, learned counsel for the private respondents.
4. Present Writ Petition has been preferred along with the Compounding Application (IA No.1 of 2024) by the petitioners.
The petitioner no.1 is in jail.
Petitioner no.2 is real brother of the petitioner no. 1.
The respondent no.3 is the complainant and respondent no.4 is the victim.
Respondent no.5 is mother of the victim.
5. The petitioner no.1 married with respondent no.4 on 15.11.2023 in a temple (Shiv Mandir) and the photographs of the marriage is also annexed with the Writ Petition.
It is submitted that the victim-respondent no. 4 is also four months pregnant from the petitioner no.1.

Respondent no.3 Shekhar Chandra, who is the complainant, is also present in Court and submits that due to some confusion and misunderstanding, the First Information Report has been lodged, though the fact that petitioner no.1 married with respondent no.4.
6. Mr. V.K.Jemini, learned Deputy Advocate General appearing for the respondents-State submits that it appears that when the marriage took place the victim was minor.
However, he seeks time to file the objection.

7. Let the objection be filed within three weeks.
8.
The petitioner no.1 is already in jail.
However, the petitioner no.2, who is real brother of petitioner no.1 is present in Court prays for interim protection.

WPCRL/504/2024 on 16 May, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/195791173/
1 9.

After taking into consideration that the petitioner no.1 married with respondent no. 4 and the petitioner no.2 is real brother of petitioner no. 1, till the objection is filed by the State, for an interim measure, the investigation pursuant to FIR No. 0408 of 2023, under Sections 363, 366, 376(2), 506 (B) of IPC and Sections 5 j (ii), 5 (m)/6 of the Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012,
registered at PS Sitarganj, District Udham Singh Nagar may go on, however, the petitioner no.2 shall not be arrested provided he cooperates with the investigation.
